about: IngredientDensities. An ingredient matches by the END of its name, longest alias first (ties keep file order); Japanese has no spaces, so the end is by character ('有塩バター' is 'バター'), and a compound that would wrongly match a shorter alias needs a skip entry. gramsPerCup is per US cup (236.6 ml); null is a skip entry: recognised, never converted, and it wins over a shorter alias by being longer. liquid: pourable (the 'Also convert liquids' option). stickable: allows the 'stick' unit. Only ingredients that weigh about the same every time belong here. trailingModifiers are dropped from the end of the name before matching. No bare 油 (it would match 醤油) and no bare 粉 (片栗粉, パン粉).

entries.note: Flours, as the English table (King Arthur): 薄力粉 is cake flour.
